education.title: Raise money for school fees and learning
education.description: School and university fees, exams, books or training. Give your education goal a page your family, church and alumni can share.

health.title: Raise money for medical bills and emergencies
health.description: Surgery, treatment, hospital bills, or getting back on your feet after an accident, fire or flood. Get help quickly from the people who care.

church.title: Raise money for church and faith projects
church.description: A new building, renovations, equipment, outreach or a special programme. Give your congregation one link to rally around.

creators.title: Raise money for your film, music, book or craft
creators.description: Your first album, a short film, a book, an exhibition or the tools to make your craft. Let the people who believe in you back you.

community.title: Raise money for your community
community.description: A borehole, repairs to a school, solar power, a clean-up or support for neighbours. Bring everyone behind one goal.

business.title: Raise money for your small business
business.description: Starting out, restocking after a loss, new equipment or repairs to your shop. Let your customers and community help you grow.

milestones.title: Raise money for weddings and life’s big moments
milestones.description: Weddings, send-offs, memorials, naming ceremonies and graduations. Give friends and family near and far one place to join in.

story.title: How to write a story people want to support
story.description: Your story does the asking for you. Make it clear, honest and easy to share.

cover.title: How to choose a cover photo
cover.description: The first thing people see when your link is shared. Make it count.

goal.title: How to set a goal people trust
goal.description: A goal people can understand is a goal people want to help reach.

share.title: How to share your page on WhatsApp and beyond
share.description: Most support comes from people who know you. Here’s how to reach them.

updates.title: How to post updates that bring new support
updates.description: Updates keep supporters close and give you a reason to share again.

thanks.title: How to thank your supporters
thanks.description: A good thank-you turns supporters into people who’ll help again.
